criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`. It passes, and `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list` shows the same test names as before, with only the new introspect test added, which the request requires. Report the counts.
criteria.evidence: Athena's record: `cargo test --locked` passed, 1395 tests ran. Measured on the candidate: athena-core has 476 lib tests (the introspect run reported 12 passed and 464 filtered out) and the external_calls_guard test has 2. A gh test keeps its path, `gh::tests::the_client_runs_only_gh_api_with_rest_paths`, because the module path does not change when gh.rs becomes gh/mod.rs. The zero-context diff of crates/ removes and renames no test function and adds exactly one `#[test]`, `introspect::tests::a_landing_touching_a_file_under_gh_selects_d87_and_d88`. So the base count is 475 lib tests; that number is derived, not measured, because building the base would need a git checkout. I could not count lines in the saved --list output: it was written outside the working directory, where reads are denied.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. Both are clean, and no `#[allow]` is added.
criteria.evidence: Athena's records show both commands passed on this tree. The diff of crates/ adds no `#[allow]`.

criteria.criterion: `crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs` no longer exists and `crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs` does. `git diff -M` shows it as a rename whose only changed lines, if any, are `use` lines, and moved text is identical.
criteria.evidence: The diff shows `similarity index 100%`, `rename from crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs`, `rename to crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs`, with no changed lines. Grep finds no `include_str!` or `#[path]` in gh/mod.rs whose relative path could break when the file moves down a directory.

criteria.criterion: A new test in introspect.rs shows that a landing touching a moved file under `crates/athena-core/src/gh/` still selects D87 and D88 through their `paths`. Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core introspect` to see it pass. It would fail if `paths` still named only the old `gh.rs`.
criteria.evidence: `introspect::tests::a_landing_touching_a_file_under_gh_selects_d87_and_d88 ... ok`, 12 passed. Grep for `.paths` over crates/ finds no production code that matches DecisionHeader.paths; the only use is the new test helper. So the test does what the accepted reading allowed: it uses a small prefix-match helper. Entries ending in `/` match by prefix and all other entries match exactly. With the old entry `crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs`, `gh/mod.rs` would not match, the selection would be empty, and the `assert_eq!(..., ["D87", "D88"])` would fail. The test also checks that `gh.rs`, `ghost/mod.rs` and `run.rs` select neither decision.

criteria.criterion: D87 and D88 in `introspect.rs` list `crates/athena-core/src/gh/` and no longer list the exact path `crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs`.
criteria.evidence: Diff lines 148 and 191: `paths: vec!["crates/athena-core/src/gh/"]` replaces `gh.rs`. The only remaining `gh.rs` string in introspect.rs is line 1635, a negative case inside the new test.

criteria.criterion: external_calls_guard.rs `WRAPPER` is the prefix `crates/athena-core/src/gh/`. Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core --test external_calls_guard`. summary: The candidate does job G1 as asked, and I found nothing blocking. `gh.rs` is now `gh/mod.rs` as a pure rename: git reports 100% similarity, so no line inside the file changed. D87 and D88 in introspect.rs now list `crates/athena-core/src/gh/`. A new test checks that files under `gh/` select both decisions and that the old `gh.rs` and `ghost/` do not. That test would fail if the old exact path were still listed. The guard's WRAPPER constant is now the `gh/` prefix, compared with `starts_with`. Its self-test still flags a `gh` call outside `gh/` and allows one in `gh/mod.rs` and in `gh/sub/part.rs`. D138 is marked accepted with the four required points, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry under [Unreleased]. I ran the introspect tests (12 passed) and the guard tests (2 passed), and checked that one gh test keeps its module path. Athena's records show fmt, clippy and the full test run passing (1395 tests). One count was derived, not measured: I could not build the base commit without changing git state, so the base unit-test count of 475 (476 now, minus the one new test) comes from the diff, which removes and renames no test function. The unchanged caller counts likewise come from the diff, not from running the greps at base. Two minor follow-ups remain. docs/system-facts.md, which is built into agent briefs, and docs/architecture.md still cite `crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs` as a source path; section 5 rule 7 kept this job from editing them. The optional structure-pass.md pointer marking G1 done was not added.
